label.zh: 炸开墓室：盗墓或墓地守卫
label.en: Blasting in: tomb raiding or guardians

note.zh: 选择炸开或破拆后，本阶段要么突破进入墓室（1720），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败，放出墓地守卫（1725）。
note.en: After choosing to blast or break in, the stage either breaks through into the tomb (1720) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll, releasing the Grave Guardians (1725).

note.zh: 墓中有水晶巨骨与贡品；获得矿物、合金、500 稀有晶体、稀有文物与凝聚力；灵能科学家另得一项灵能研究选项。探索结束。
note.en: A crystalline giant's skeleton surrounded by offerings; minerals, alloys, 500 rare crystals, minor artefacts and unity; a psionic scientist also yields a psionics research option. The exploration ends.

note.zh: 失败分支：隐藏墓室里的守卫随探球冲出裂隙，在裂隙所在处生成一支敌对的“墓地守卫”舰队（10–30 艘）。探索结束。
note.en: Failure branch: guardians from a hidden chamber follow the Sphere out of the rift; a hostile Grave Guardians fleet (10–30 ships) appears at the rift. The exploration ends.

notes.zh: “取一些样本就回来”（1715.a）直接结束探索，获得中量星界丝缕；“进行破坏性破拆”（1715.b）给大量星界丝缕并继续冒险。
notes.en: “Take samples and return.” (1715.a) ends the exploration at once with a medium astral thread reward; “Engage destructive exploration.” (1715.b) gives a large reward and continues the risk.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 1700–1725 全部事件，补上三处 on_roll_failed 失败分支 1725（原为独立故事）。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 1700–1725; added the three on_roll_failed fallbacks to 1725 (formerly a separate story).
